note: Singapore's Immigration & Checkpoints Authority: holders of travel documents issued by the 33 countries and places it lists need a visa, as do Palestinian Authority passport holders; everyone else enters without one, the period of stay granted by the officer at the checkpoint and notified by e-Pass (the SG Arrival Card is an arrival declaration, not an authorisation, so it isn't modelled). The visa-free transit facility isn't modelled.

sources.title: Immigration & Checkpoints Authority, Visa Requirements (last updated 25 June 2026)
sources.said: If your travel document is issued by one of the countries/ places listed below, you will require a valid visa to enter Singapore. Click on individual countries/ places to find out more. Afghanistan Algeria Armenia Azerbaijan Bangladesh Belarus Democratic People's Republic of Korea Egypt Georgia India Iran Iraq Jordan Kazakhstan Kosovo Kyrgyzstan Lebanon Libya Mali Moldova Morocco Nigeria Pakistan Russia Somalia South Sudan Sudan Syria Tajikistan Tunisia Turkmenistan Ukraine Uzbekistan Yemen You will also need a visa if you are travelling on: ... A Palestinian Authority passport ... The e-Pass notification will indicate the period of stay granted and last day of stay allowed.
